question: What blocks 2241 Mahon St, and what would unlock it?
method: Playwright, fresh browser context, app root with no parameters; the path a first-time user can see: the search box in the header.
caveat: This times the interface path with a script. It is not a study with people; the judge panel and the team supply the human check.

steps.what: "What blocks it" names the side setbacks

answer.sentence: Since May 2025, 2241 Mahon St meets the minimum lot size exactly (2,400 sf). A two-unit house still gets 4 ft.
answer.what_fits: WHAT FITS 4ft wide, as of right · by deed · 3.4 ft on the City map
answer.what_blocks_it: WHAT BLOCKS IT Only with subsidy (screening estimate) ✕ MONEY vertical cost alone exceeds the highest value signal by at least $83,000 per home ✕ RULES doesn't fit as of right: side setbacks 10 → 4 ft on each side — SITE not assessed: soil, environmental, water and sewer Vertical construction alone ($351,000–$405,000 per home) exceeds the highest value signal ($268,000) by at least $83,000 per home, before site work, land, soft costs and financing.
answer.what_to_do_next: WHAT TO DO NEXT Two-unit house on lots 24–25: 28 ft, but it needs a lot that isn’t City-owned. TRY IT Fewest approvals overall: detached house on lot 25 alone (18 ft).
